preview.manifest:
apiVersion: maku.ogenki.io/v1alpha1
kind: MergePolicy
metadata:
  name: cloud-native-ref
  namespace: agent-system
spec:
  classes:
    dashboards: {}
    docs:
      escalation:
        notConverged: rich
      harness: base
      harnessAllowed:
      - rich
    docs-links:
      live: true
    revert:
      shadow: true
    tests: {}
  merge:
    autoMergesPerDay: 10
    awaitingCIFor: 24h0m0s
    breaker:
      maxReverts: 1
      window: 10
    checkReruns: 1
    fixRuns: 2
    leakScanCheck: "Security scanning \U0001F512"
    mergerLogin: ogenki-agent-merger[bot]
    policyBotLogin: ogenki-merge-gate[bot]
    requiredChecks:
    - "Pre-commit checks \U0001F6C3"
    - "Security scanning \U0001F512"
    - Kubernetes validation ☸
    - "Rendered manifest diff \U0001F4DD"
    - "Check the shell scripts \U0001F4BB"
    - "Check the documentation links \U0001F517"
    - Validate Vector Log Parsing Configuration (vlsingle)
    - Validate Vector Log Parsing Configuration (vlcluster)
    revertWindow: 168h0m0s
    verifyChecks:
    - "Pre-commit checks \U0001F6C3"
    - "Security scanning \U0001F512"
    - Kubernetes validation ☸
    - "Check the shell scripts \U0001F4BB"
    - "Check the documentation links \U0001F517"
    verifyFor: 30m0s
  repositoryRef: cloud-native-ref
